title: IHC Fluorescent Frozen Sections
author: Elizabeth Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7ayhifw
materials: blocking buffer (10% normal donkey serum in 1.0% BSA)

steps.title: Create water barrier
steps.instruction: Using a PAP Pen, draw a water‑barrier circle around each tissue section on the slide and allow it to dry for several seconds up to approximately one minute.

steps.title: PBS washes (Day 1)
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides with PBS (pH 7.3–7.4) for four washes, each lasting 5 minutes.

steps.title: BSA/Triton wash (Day 1)
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides once with 0.5 % BSA + 0.4 % Triton X‑100 in PBS for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Dry slides
steps.instruction: Remove slides one at a time and, using a clean Kimwipe, gently wipe around the tissue sections to dry the slide.

steps.title: Place in humidity box
steps.instruction: Place the slides into a black, covered slide incubation/humidity box.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Cover the tissue sections with blocking buffer (10 % normal donkey serum in 1.0 % BSA + 0.4 % Triton X‑100 in PBS) and incubate for 1.5–2 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Remove blocking buffer
steps.instruction: Pour off the blocking buffer from each slide.

steps.title: Add primary antibody
steps.instruction: Replace the buffer with primary antibody solution (antibody of choice diluted in 1.0 % BSA + 0.4 % Triton X‑100 in PBS).

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the slides with primary antibody overnight in the incubation box at room temperature.

steps.title: PBS washes (Day 2)
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides with PBS for four washes, each lasting 5 minutes.

steps.title: BSA/Triton wash (Day 2)
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides once with 0.5 % BSA + 0.4 % Triton X‑100 in PBS for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Place in humidity box
steps.instruction: Place the slides into a black, covered slide incubation/humidity box.

steps.title: Block again
steps.instruction: Cover the tissue sections with blocking buffer (10 % normal donkey serum in 1.0 % BSA + 0.4 % Triton X‑100 in PBS) and incubate for 1.5–2 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute the fluorescent secondary antibody in 1.0 % BSA + 0.4 % Triton X‑100 in PBS.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Cover the tissue with the secondary antibody solution and incubate for 2 hours at room temperature in the incubation box; from this point on, keep slides protected from light.

steps.title: PBS washes post‑secondary
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides with PBS for four washes, each lasting 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove excess PBS
steps.instruction: Gently blot any remaining PBS from the slide surface with a Kimwipe.

steps.title: Mount with cover glass
steps.instruction: Add a drop of mounting medium to the center of the tissue, place a cover glass, and seal the edges with clear nail polish; for thicker tissue, place a weight on the cover glass before sealing.
